# Amber & Sage Spa

> Amber & Sage Spa is a holistic day spa in Chattanooga, Tennessee, located at 1202 Hixson Pike in North Chattanooga. We offer organic facials (partnered with Éminence Organic Skin Care), therapeutic massage, reiki, sound baths, aura photography (using the AuraCloud 3D Pro system), lash and brow services, waxing, and body scrubs. We are by appointment only and open Monday through Sunday.

Our services are built around a holistic wellness philosophy: bodywork, skincare, and nervous-system care in one intentionally quiet space. We are a Proudly Partnered Éminence Organic Skin Care provider — one of a small number in the region. All facials use biodynamic, organic products.

## Location & Contact

- Address: 1202 Hixson Pike, Chattanooga, TN 37405
- Phone: (423) 218-2841
- Text: (423) 537-4221
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9am–7pm, Sunday 10am–7pm (by appointment only)

## Facial services

- [Éminence Organic Facials](https://amberandsagespa.com/eminence-organic-facials-chattanooga.html): Anchor page for our facial menu including Express Facial, Personalized Éminence Facial, Dermaplane Facial, Single Dermaplane, Acne Facial, Microderm Facial, Intraceuticals Oxygen Glow, Glow and Sculpt, and Buccal Facial Massage.
- [Microdermabrasion Facials](https://amberandsagespa.com/microderm-facial-chattanooga.html): Diamond-tip microderm — Express (30 min) and full (1 hour) options.
- [Acne Facial](https://amberandsagespa.com/acne-facial-chattanooga.html): Comprehensive six-step protocol combining extractions, Éminence enzyme exfoliation, high frequency therapy, and light therapy.
- [Glow and Sculpt Facial](https://amberandsagespa.com/glow-and-sculpt-facial-chattanooga.html): 45-minute dermaplane + hydrating jelly mask + cool jade comb sculpting.
- [Best Facial in Chattanooga](https://amberandsagespa.com/best-facial-chattanooga.html): Editorial guide to what makes a great facial and how ours compare.

- [Seasonal Body Scrub](https://amberandsagespa.com/body-scrub-chattanooga.html): 30-minute full-body exfoliation with Éminence's Coconut Sugar Scrub. Standalone or as an enhancement.

- [What is Cupping Therapy?](https://amberandsagespa.com/what-is-cupping-therapy.html): Cupping explained, including the truth about the marks (not bruises).
- [What is Red Light Therapy?](https://amberandsagespa.com/what-is-red-light-therapy.html): Photobiomodulation explained honestly — what the research supports and what it doesn't.
- [What is Reiki?](https://amberandsagespa.com/what-is-reiki.html): Reiki explained through both physiological and traditional lenses.
- [What is Graston Technique?](https://amberandsagespa.com/what-is-graston-technique.html): Instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization explained for athletic recovery.
- [What is Myofascial Stretch Therapy?](https://amberandsagespa.com/what-is-myofascial-stretch-therapy.html): Assisted stretching explained.
- [What is Aura Photography?](https://amberandsagespa.com/what-is-aura-photography.html): Aura photography from Kirlian to modern AuraCloud 3D Pro systems.
